name: Saikaishita Tomo wa Hakuchou ni Natta
original_name: 再会した友は白鳥になった
source:
The protagonist reunites in high school with one of their old elementary school friends, Shirahairo.
But for some reason, the person they’ve reconnected with has turned into a swan…!?
A surreal, silly youth-themed comedy game where a casual remark from the protagonist sends things spiraling in an entirely unexpected direction!
